title: 🎉 Fivem Federal Bank Multiplayer Heist Script - MAP + MINIGAMEPACK + NPC DIALOG 🎉
description: FRKN-Bank Heist delivers an unparalleled heist experience for your FiveM servers. Players take on unique roles, working together as a team in this dynamic, story-driven adventure. This is not just a heist—it's a teamwork-driven story brought to life! Map open source is not provided.

fields.name: 🛠️ Features
fields.value:
• Every task immerses players in a gripping narrative, offering a variety of challenges.
• Every stage is enriched with a compelling narrative.
• Success hinges on players fulfilling their roles effectively.
• Built to deliver a seamless experience for all servers.

fields.name: ⚙️ How It Works
fields.value:
• Retrieve blueprints while interacting with NPCs.
• Disable cameras with the drone.
• Hack, sabotage, and plant bombs to clear the way.
• Take down an airplane, secure the bank manager, and finish the mission.
